allowlisted_fields.status: null or success -> succeeded; failure -> failed; all other values reject
allowlisted_fields.startTime: parse as UTC instant and emit start_time at exact microsecond precision
allowlisted_fields.endTime: parse as UTC instant and emit end_time at exact microsecond precision
allowlisted_fields.model_group: exact valid UTF-8 bytes when nonempty, otherwise absent
allowlisted_fields.custom_llm_provider: provider exact valid UTF-8 bytes when nonempty, otherwise absent
allowlisted_fields.total_tokens: nonnegative int64 -> canonical decimal string and exact prompt+completion sum
allowlisted_fields.spend: parse exact JSON numeric token as nonnegative decimal and emit canonical reported_spend
allowlisted_fields.cache_hit: JSON true or string True -> hit; JSON false or string False -> miss; JSON null or empty string -> unknown; all other values reject
